description: Searches live offers from verified shop feeds in one market (country or market: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 for the EU, EEA, GB and CH, or ALL for the markets that are switched on), in that market's currency. An unknown market is an error; a market without a live catalogue answers empty or thin with sparse_market=true and never borrows another market's prices silently. Results are grouped by currency and ordered by total price including known shipping; commission is never used (commission_used_in_ranking=false). q also reads sizes, ages, budgets and head sizes ('str 33', 'til 3-åring', 'under 5000 kr', '52 cm hode'). Each product has comparison_type: price (two or more independent shops) or single (one shop or one owner), and the card fields image, total, currency, merchant and go_url. When the market asked for has no match, market_fallback names the market the results come from. Shop links are affiliate links. Hosts with MCP Apps show the results as product cards.

age_min_months.description: Youngest age in months. With age_max_months, ranges must overlap.

age_min_years.description: Scooter or bike: minimum age in years

age_months.description: Child age in months. The product range must contain it.

ball_type.description: Football: light, training, match or futsal

category.description: Category slug: winter-outdoor, racket-sports, football, shoes, kids-baby, clothing, military-outdoor, electronics, beauty-care, trading-cards, video-games, other. Every product in an answer has one of these in category. Deprecated, still accepted for at least 30 days from 2026-11-28: toys (deprecated, bruk kids-baby); menswear (deprecated, bruk clothing); beauty (deprecated, bruk beauty-care).

child_height_cm.description: Car seat: child height the approved range must contain

child_weight_kg.description: Car seat: child weight the approved range must contain

closure.description: Football boots: laces, velcro or laceless

country.description: Market, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2: NO, SE, DK, FI, DE, AT, CH, NL, BE, LU, FR, ES, IT, PT, PL, IE, GB, CZ, SK, HU, RO, BG, HR, SI, GR, CY, MT, EE, LV, LT, IS, LI; or ALL (switched-on markets). Unknown codes (e.g. XX) are an error. Not the language: use lang for that.

currency.description: ISO 4217, optional. Must be the market's currency (NO NOK, SE SEK, DK DKK, DE EUR, GB GBP, CH CHF, PL PLN, …); another currency is an error.

detail.description: summary (default): per product name, brand, category, gtin, size, comparison_type, and per offer merchant, price_incl_shipping, in_stock, variants, price_checked_at and human_click_url. full: every field, descriptions cut to 160 characters.

eu_size.description: Football boots: EU size. 'str 33' with boots sets this.

gtin.description: Valid GTIN-8/12/13/14. Invalid codes do not match.

head_cm.description: Helmet: head circumference the size range must contain

in_stock.description: true to keep only in-stock offers

lang.description: Language of the texts in the answer (not the market). Default en.

market.description: Same as country (one of them is enough).

max_child_kg_min.description: Stroller: product must allow at least this child weight

max_user_kg.description: Scooter or bike: max user weight

max_user_kg_min.description: Scooter or bike: product must allow at least this user weight

nff_age.description: Football: NFF age band derived from ball size

price_checked_since.description: ISO date. Offer price_checked_at must be on or after this.

price_max.description: Maximum item price in the offer currency

price_min.description: Minimum item price in the offer currency

q.description: Free text: product name, GTIN, words, size, age or budget.

shipping_max.description: Maximum shipping in the offer currency

size_cm.description: Kids clothing: body size 50-176. 'str 92' with clothing sets this.

small_parts_under_3.description: Toys: small parts warning for under 3

sole_type.description: Football boots: FG, AG, SG, MG, TF or IC

total_dkk_max.description: Maximum total incl. shipping in DKK.

total_nok_max.description: Maximum total incl. shipping in NOK (other currencies: total_nok_estimate, an estimate with Norges Bank's rate). Norwegian 'under 5000 kr' sets this.

total_nok_min.description: Minimum total incl. shipping in NOK. Other currencies are compared by total_nok_estimate (an estimate with Norges Bank's rate of the day); offers without a fresh rate are left out.

total_sek_max.description: Maximum total incl. shipping in SEK. Swedish 'under 500 kr' sets this.

wheel_size_inch.description: Scooter or bike: wheel size in inches

name: search_offers

examples.links: human_click_url is an affiliate link for a person to click (show it to the person; do not fetch or prefetch it).

market.description: The market asked for (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) or ALL.

market_fallback.description: Only for switched-on markets: names exactly which market borrowed results come from.

market_message.description: Plain text about a sparse market, in lang.

market_state.description: few_shops: the selection is being built; coming: no prices yet.

sparse_market.description: True when the market is not switched on yet: results are few or none, never borrowed silently.
